_note: Casting lines: what each character says in their casting takes (tools/td-vo-cast.py). A clone copies the energy of the take it is cloned from, so these show who they are: some attitude, a question, an exclamation, about ten seconds. The first clone references were a bland line 'in your usual voice' and every clone came out monotone (the user, 2026-10-11). Heard only on the casting page, never in an episode.
Heather: Oh, please. You really thought I wouldn't notice? I notice everything. So here's how this goes: you vote with me tonight, or you're the next one walking down that dock. Got it?
Owen: Oh man, oh man, did you guys smell that? Chef made pancakes! Real ones! Okay, okay, I'm totally calm. Who wants to share? Nobody? Great, more for me!
Gwen: Wow. Another challenge in the mud. Shocking. Look, I'm not here to make friends, okay? I just want to get through today without anybody talking to me. Is that so much to ask?
Duncan: Relax, I'm not gonna hurt anybody. Probably. You want my advice? Keep your head down, stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine. Unless you snore.
Courtney: Excuse me? No. Absolutely not. I have a plan, and the plan works if everybody does exactly what I say. Is that clear? Good. Now, who left this mess on the dock?
Izzy: Okay, so, true story: I once wrestled a bear. Or the bear wrestled me, details! Wanna see my moves? No? Too bad! Ha! Where did everybody go?
Cody: Hey! So, uh, I was thinking, maybe we could be partners for the challenge? Not in a weird way. Unless you want it to be a little weird. Too much? Yeah, too much.
Sierra: Oh my gosh, oh my gosh, do you know how long I've waited for this? I know every challenge, every vote, every single thing anybody's ever said here! This is the best day of my life!
Lindsay: Wait, which one are you again? Oh! Sorry! You all kind of look the same when you're not wearing a headband. Anyway, I love your shoes! Are those new?
Harold: Actually, I've been training for this exact scenario my entire life. I have mad skills in archery, nunchucks and calligraphy. So, technically, I'm the most qualified person here. Gosh!
Leshawna: Mm-hmm. Honey, let me tell you something. I don't do fake, and I can smell it from across this camp. You want to come at my friends? You come through me first.
Noah: Let me get this straight. We're supposed to carry a canoe across an island, for fun? Wow. Great. I'll be over here, reading, if anybody needs me to not care.
Bridgette: Hey, you guys, come on. Can we not fight today? We're all tired and hungry, and honestly, yelling isn't gonna make the water any warmer. Let's just breathe, okay?
Geoff: Dude! Party at the campfire tonight! Everybody's invited, even the grumpy ones! Come on, man, we won today! We gotta celebrate! Who's bringing the snacks?
Trent: Look, guys, I get it. Everybody's stressed. But turning on each other isn't gonna help anybody win. I'd rather lose playing it straight than win like that. That's just me.
Alejandro: Ah, my friend, you misunderstand me. I only want what is best for the team. And for you, of course. Trust me. Have I ever given you a reason not to?
Chris: Welcome back! Today's challenge is going to be extreme, dangerous, and totally hilarious... for me! Somebody is going home tonight, and I cannot wait. Stay tuned!
